reviews.review:
I have to say, this his honestly a step down from the previous game.

First weapons are pretty nice, felt like most of the work was put into the animations for them. Second level design is a step down from the Reimu DLC from the first game rather open empty levels in the first half of the game where the second half a collection of rooms slapped together with little cohesion. Third the music doesn't really fit the levels at all. Sigyaad Team has proven they can do better, but I felt like this should've been developed in GZDoom instead of making the leap to Unity and most importantly needs to rely less on updates to improve the game. The game is obviously rushed and needing to rely on updates to improve things is honestly quite sad to see, wish the developer can learn from this and improve. Currently I'd give it a 4/10 maybe I'll change my mind if the developer actually updates and improves the game but for now I'd wait to purchase the game
